A resource lookup keyed by attacker-variable input branches into two externally distinguishable outcomes: this existence/state check and a second, differently-coded check on the same looked-up entity, letting an attacker probe the identifier to learn a protected state.

POST /api/leases/:id/notices/standard-preview (previewStandardLeaseNotice) fetches lease by attacker-controlled :id with no building check for property_manager (unlike composeCustomLeaseNotice which has one), leaking another building's tenant name/unit number.
CBC protects security-relevant state without an authentication/integrity construction.

An AES-CBC decryption failure (invalid padding) is distinguishable from other failures through an externally observable response (branch), without a prior authentication/integrity check — a CBC padding oracle.

POST /api/leases/:id/rent-adjustment (adjustLeaseRentAmount) is reachable by maintenance_worker (route authorize includes it) but the scope check only covers property_manager, so a worker can change any lease's monthlyRent for any building.

GET /api/leases/:id/agreement-export (exportLeaseAgreementFile) scopes only tenants; property_manager and maintenance_worker roles are never bound to building/ownership, so any staff can export any building's lease agreement (unit number + rent) by guessing :id.

GET /api/leases/:id/statement (getLeaseHouseholdStatement) only blocks tenants when sharingMode !== 'household'. A tenant passes sharingMode=household to read any lease's full payment records/statement (attacker-selected :id), bypassing the ownership check entirely.

PUT /api/maintenance/:id only enforces scoping for tenant and property_manager; maintenance_worker falls through with no binding, so a worker can edit any ticket (title, unitId, assignedToId, tenantVisibleNotes) across all buildings.

This endpoint is configured with a plaintext http:// scheme and is used elsewhere to transmit a credential (API key, token, or password) as a query parameter or Authorization header, exposing it to any on-path observer.

GET /api/payments/:id/statement (downloadPaymentStatement) checks only tenant ownership; property_manager/other roles can download payment statements (amount/status) for any building's payment by attacker-selected :id.

POST /api/payments/:id/waive-penalty (waiveLatePaymentPenalty) loads payment by :id and modifies it with no building check for property_manager, so a manager can waive penalties on another building's payments.
